_comment: FROZEN CONTRACT v1. Person 1 renders this. Person 2 produces this. Person 3 transports this. Changes need all-3 agreement, same day, announced in group chat.

traits.name: Stature
traits.explanation: Height from ground to top of the withers.

traits.name: Heart Girth
traits.explanation: Circumference of the chest just behind the front legs, from the 3D body model.

traits.name: Body Length
traits.explanation: Point of shoulder to pin bone.

traits.name: Body Depth
traits.explanation: Depth of the barrel at the last rib.

traits.name: Angularity
traits.explanation: Openness and angle of the rib structure.

traits.name: Rump Angle
traits.explanation: Slope from hip bone to pin bone.

traits.name: Rear Legs Set
traits.explanation: Angle at the hock, side view. Subjective trait - wider uncertainty is normal.

traits.name: Rear Legs Rear View
traits.explanation: Straightness of the legs seen from behind, judged across the walking video. Subjective trait.

traits.name: Foot Angle
traits.explanation: Angle of the front hoof wall to the ground. Subjective trait.

traits.name: Fore Udder Attachment
traits.explanation: How strongly the front of the udder blends into the body wall. Subjective trait.

traits.name: Rear Udder Height
traits.explanation: Distance from vulva base to the milk-secreting tissue.

traits.name: Central Ligament
traits.explanation: Depth of the cleft between the two udder halves. Subjective trait.

traits.name: Udder Depth
traits.explanation: Udder floor position relative to the hock.

traits.name: Front Teat Placement
traits.explanation: Position of front teats on their quarters. Subjective trait.

traits.name: Teat Length
traits.explanation: Measured on the left front teat for cattle, left REAR teat for buffalo.

traits.name: Rear Teat Placement
traits.explanation: Position of rear teats on their quarters. Subjective trait.

traits.name: Rear Udder Width
traits.explanation: Width of the rear udder attachment.

traits.name: Teat Thickness
traits.not_scored_reason: Teats not clearly visible in the rear photo - confidence too low. Retake closer rear photo to score this trait.

traits.name: Body Condition Score
traits.explanation: Fat cover assessed from pelvic and tailhead surface shape. Subjective trait.

reports.farmer: plain-language summary for the farmer (always ends with the not-a-diagnosis disclaimer)
reports.vet: technical summary for the veterinary officer

_rules_for_all_three_of_us: score is null when the system refuses to score - the app MUST show not_scored_reason, never a fake number
1 and 9 are biological extremes, not bad/good - the app must NEVER color-code scores as quality
measured_value is evidence for the score, shown in the tap-to-explain screen
measure_class: A=angle (no scale), B=ratio (no scale), C=needs ear-tag cm scale, SMAL=needs 3D model
the 8 officially-subjective traits are allowed lower confidence - that is honest, not broken
buffalo: teat traits measured on left REAR teat; rump width landmarks differ
